charter.objective: Make an ordinary project easier for an AI agent to inhabit through a provenance-bound semantic twin while canonical files remain normal and authoritative.
hard_constraints: No generic shell primitive in the agent protocol
No semantic precision upgrade without provider evidence
Missing providers remain explicit capability gaps
Engineering measurements are not promoted to token/task-success/AGI claims

belief_updates.belief: File digest alone is sufficient compile-cache identity
belief_updates.observation: Compiler/provider artifacts can change while source bytes remain unchanged
belief_updates.change: Added compiler-cache and provider/toolchain fingerprints plus legacy-cache migration probe

belief_updates.belief: Per-file cache reuse is enough to make cross-file semantics precise
belief_updates.observation: Duplicate-name calls remained ambiguous without project semantic resolution
belief_updates.change: Added Python project linker and TypeScript Program+TypeChecker semantics

belief_updates.belief: Adding a correct semantic graph edge is enough for context quality
belief_updates.observation: Lexical duplicate could remain over-ranked and graph cycles could self-reinforce
belief_updates.change: Context V3 reranks with semantic evidence, distinct-root reinforcement, cycle protection and production-root expansion

belief_updates.belief: Browser provider lifecycle is validated by isolated UI tests
belief_updates.observation: Full suite exposed Playwright sync-driver collision across workspaces
belief_updates.change: Process-shared browser engine with workspace-scoped contexts

belief_updates.belief: Benchmark scripts running in the development environment proves release reproducibility
belief_updates.observation: Direct benchmark execution failed due to import-root assumptions
belief_updates.change: Self-bootstrapping benchmark scripts and extracted-release execution gate

claim_boundary: Alpha.2 demonstrates bounded semantic/incremental/runtime plumbing on included fixtures. It does not demonstrate universal repository understanding, reduced LLM tokens, AGI capability or production isolation.
